name: Master Alchemist
benefits: This is a skill feat that scales with your ranks in Craft (Alchemy).

scaleBenefits.benefit: The Save DC's for Alchemical Items you use are equal to 10 + your Ranks in Craft (Alchemy) + your Int modifier. Additionally you Craft Alchemical Items ten times faster.
When using an Alchemical Item, you may now use an additional Alchemical Item with the same action, such as bundling together a Tanglefoot Bag and a Burst Jar into one thrown attack.
You may add your Intelligence modifier to die rolls associated with Alchemical Items. Additionally you may craft mundane Alchemical Items as a standard action.

When using an Alchemical Item, you may now use two additional Alchemical Items with the same action, such as bundling together a Tanglefoot Bag, an Alchemist's Fire and a Burst Jar into one thrown attack.
All numerical aspects of Alchemical Items you use are maximized. Additionally, you may craft any Alchemical Item as a swift action.
